title: Abba bar Chama
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Avodah Zarah 31a](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.31a.7), Rav Chisda says, “Abba bar Chama told me that Zeira ruled in accordance with Rabbi Eliezer.” Hyman gives Abba bar Chanan as the Dikdukei Soferim reading. In [Avodah Zarah 49b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.49b.6), Rav Chisda says, “Abba bar Rav Chisda told me that Zeiri ruled in accordance with Rabbi Eliezer.” Hyman would read bar Chanan. In [Avodah Zarah 60b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.60b.10), Rav Chisda says, “Abba bar Chanan told me that Zeiri ruled in accordance with Rabbi Shimon.” Hyman reports Abba bar Cham in Dikdukei Soferim, the Rashba’s Torat HaBayit 133a, and Yuchasin, which cites the chapter Rabbi Yishmael.[^1]

notes.text: In [Yuchasin (London 1857), p. 100](https://www.daat.ac.il/daat/vl/yohasin-zakut/yohasin-zakut08.pdf#page=4), the entry is headed Abba bar Cham. It quotes Rav Chisda saying “Abba bar Cham told me” and cites the chapter Rabbi Yishmael. The consulted Bavli has Chama, bar Rav Chisda, and Chanan in the three passages, and writes Zeiri in all three. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=25&lang=en) records Abba bar Cham but refers readers elsewhere and questions the reading. The exact Torat HaBayit and Dikdukei Soferim editions remain Hyman’s reports.
